desc: Derive the functional-graph decomposition using indegree-zero pruning and identify all cycle vertices.
Define and verify the exact-value DP recurrence for non-cycle vertices and its prefix-sum optimization.
Compute each cycle component’s contribution by enforcing a common value across all cycle vertices.
Assemble an \(O(NM)\) implementation with modular arithmetic and safe recursion depth.
Check edge cases: self-loops, multiple cycles/components, a single cycle, \(M=1\), and all vertices pointing to one node.
